definitions.explanation: Physical exercises that extend muscles and improve flexibility.

examples.japanese: ⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ストレッチ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧ストレッチ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{軽|かる}く→軽い：00785_karui⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Stretching every morning makes your body feel lighter.

examples.japanese: ストレッチ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{筋肉|きんにく}→筋肉：02646_kinniku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伸|の}ばす→伸ばす：01973_nobasu⟧。
examples.english: To stretch muscles with stretching exercises.

notes:
From English "stretch." In Japanese, ストレッチ primarily refers to stretching exercises done for health and flexibility, not the general act of stretching something.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ストレッチ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do stretching exercises
- ストレッチ⟦{体操|たいそう}→体操：04493_taisou⟧: stretching exercises (formal term)
- ストレッチ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to perform stretches (formal)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧ストレッチ: warm-up stretches
- ストレッチ⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧: stretch material/fabric
- ストレッチ⟦パンツ→パンツ：01374_pantsu⟧: stretch pants

USAGE:
Often used in fitness and health contexts. Japanese people commonly associate ストレッチ with the stretching done before and after exercise, ⟦ヨガ→ヨガ：04737_yoga⟧, or as part of a daily health routine. The word also appears in fashion for stretchy fabrics (ストレッチ⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{柔軟|じゅうなん}→柔軟：13101_juunan⟧⟦{体操|たいそう}→体操：04493_taisou⟧: flexibility exercises (more traditional/formal term)
- ⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧: warm-up exercises (broader term)
